title: #60 Torbjörn Arenbo: Capital Allocation and Value Creation
summary:
Arend Bo has 25 years experience working as a corporate finance advisor, portfolio manager, and risk manager. We will talk about his book, Capital Allocation and Value Creation, a market-based framework for executives. Capital allocation and value creation was published in December, 2003, and we are delighted to discuss it with
the author today.
